response.rationale: ECG shows regular narrow QRS tachycardia with regular P waves and varying PR intervals, indicating AV dissociation, which is characteristic of supraventricular tachycardia (e.g., junctional tachycardia) rather than AVNRT, where PR intervals are typically fixed. Cannon waves and variable S1 further support AV dissociation.

rejected.why: AVNRT typically has fixed PR intervals and retrograde P waves; the varying PR intervals and AV dissociation are inconsistent with AVNRT.
